title: Nutty Crispy Irish Potato Skillet
description: A hearty one-pot Irish dish featuring crispy potatoes and a nutty flavor, made with rice wine and shio-cure for added depth, suitable for a jain-friendly diet. This recipe is perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the potatoes from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the skillet and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rice wine, shio-cure, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the potatoes to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the potatoes are heated through.
Stir in the chopped cashews and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
